hooks.command: hm=$(date +%H%M); echo "Current time: $(date +%H:%M)"; if [ "$hm" -ge 2030 ] || [ "$hm" -lt 0500 ]; then echo "It is past 20:30. Stop working now and suggest the owner stops too."; fi
echo "If the rules below are cut off, read $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/IMPLEMENTATION.md in full with the Read tool before doing anything else."; cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/IMPLEMENTATION.md"
